prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant

assessments.note: Summary cites 4+ years building platforms and automation; mentoring experience also shown.
Python and Node.js are both listed as working skills.
Shipped full-stack edge applications with React, Hono, and Cloudflare Workers.
Built LLM pipelines integrating Google AI and OpenAI APIs with evaluation skills.
Built a LangGraph agent with tool-calling and RAG patterns.
Lists Claude Code orchestrator and sub-agent workflow skills.
Enterprise client onboarding shown, but no explicit SaaS/IPaaS platform work.
Designed integration blueprints and architected a deployed operations CRM module.
Data validation pipelines shown, but no explicit large-volume design patterns.
ETL and CRM work shown, but no business analytics or reporting integration.
VIP success and SDR roles show direct customer-facing work.
Mentoring and agent documentation shown, but no explicit non-technical communication evidence.
No evidence of travel availability or travel experience.
IT bachelor's is in progress, not CS/MIS/CIS; programming certification held.
No evidence of candidate location or US remote eligibility.

output.verdict_line: The candidate meets most required technical and AI requirements, with gaps in travel, location eligibility, and degree match.
top_gaps: Willing to travel periodically up to 15%
Remote eligible within US states where Smartsheet is registered
Bachelors in MIS, CIS, or CS (degree in progress is IT)
